name: iot-over-can
description: Experimental IoT-over-CAN platform for deterministic and stochastic event compatibility, secure local supervision and embedded diagnostics.

baseline.focus: embedded IoT network over CAN/CAN FD, not the vibration sensor function itself
baseline.wifi: disabled at boot; enabled only by TUI/operator command
baseline.security: TUI presence policy + firmware admin lease; OTP fail-closed until cryptographic verifier
baseline.heartbeat: kept as lightweight liveness lease, not logical synchronization
baseline.dtc_catalog: complete for all Pico firmware DTCs with category fallback
baseline.serial_port_selection: interactive port selection; no hardcoded /dev/ttyACM0 in run script
baseline.tui_home: generic CAN network console; vibration panel is contextual sensor detail
baseline.node_id_build: IOT_NODE_ID environment variable through PlatformIO extra script
baseline.tui_bootstrap: setup once; run script does not reinstall on every start
baseline.can_global_commands: always available; election independent of node selection
baseline.local_sensor_demo: 0xAA represented as DEMO_BYTE local sensor on CAN node
baseline.profile_ui: vibration UI visible only for PROFILE=VIBRATION
baseline.probe_zero: instrumentation only; excluded from functional topology
baseline.sensor_identity: 64-bit UUID derived from unique board ID
baseline.serial_authorization: firmware-enforced admin lease for mutating commands
baseline.wifi_provisioning: runtime credentials; DHCP; no committed SSID/password
baseline.can_command_ack: directed local-sensor administrative commands return APPLIED/REJECTED ACK
baseline.ble_discovery: not implemented; architecture prepared for next phase
baseline.cryptographic_yubico_otp: not implemented; OTP mode fails closed until real verifier
baseline.wireless_discovery: BLE advertisement on Pico W; distributed scan on functional CAN nodes

validation.platformio_build: not executed: pio unavailable in assistant environment
validation.platformio_compile_error_falhas_cpp: fixed orphan return after simulation removal
validation.serial_port_markup_error: fixed by markup=False on port list
validation.textual_runtime: not executed: textual not installed in packaging environment
validation.pico_sdk_real_build: pending on user Pico SDK environment
validation.documentation_consistency: updated for distributed wireless admission architecture
validation.textual_runtime_tests: not executed: Textual unavailable in assistant environment
